## Life on Earth {.center}

Understand how life evolved and how we know the age of our planet

::: {.notes}
Welcome to the session on Life on Earth. This is an important topic in biology and science. Throughout this session, we'll explore key concepts, look at real-world examples, and think about why this matters.
:::
